food.note: Raw chicken can make you hungry. Cook it first.
It poisons you and makes you sick.
It teleports you a short way.
It heals you and gives you extra golden hearts.
It heals you, gives you golden hearts, and protects you from fire and damage for a while.
It keeps you full the longest of any food.
It gives you a surprise effect.

aqua_affinity.name: Aqua Affinity
aqua_affinity.what: It lets you mine fast underwater.

bane_of_arthropods.name: Bane of Arthropods
bane_of_arthropods.what: It does extra damage to spiders, bees, silverfish and endermites.

binding_curse.name: Curse of Binding
binding_curse.what: It's a curse: once you put it on, you can't take it off.
binding_curse.on: armor and other things you wear

breach.name: Breach
breach.what: Mace hits get through some of the armor.

channeling.name: Channeling
channeling.what: In a thunderstorm, a trident you throw at a mob makes lightning strike it.

density.name: Density
density.what: Mace smash attacks do more damage the farther you fall.

depth_strider.name: Depth Strider
depth_strider.what: It lets you walk faster underwater.

feather_falling.name: Feather Falling
feather_falling.what: You take less damage when you fall.

fire_aspect.name: Fire Aspect
fire_aspect.what: It sets what you hit on fire.

fire_protection.name: Fire Protection
fire_protection.what: It protects you from fire and lava.

flame.name: Flame
flame.what: Your arrows set what they hit on fire.

fortune.name: Fortune
fortune.what: Some blocks drop more, like diamond ore and coal ore.

frost_walker.name: Frost Walker
frost_walker.what: It turns water into ice under your feet as you walk.

impaling.name: Impaling
impaling.what: The trident does extra damage to mobs that are in water or rain.

infinity.name: Infinity
infinity.what: You can shoot as much as you like with just one arrow.

knockback.name: Knockback
knockback.what: It knocks mobs farther back when you hit them.

loyalty.name: Loyalty
loyalty.what: The trident flies back to you after you throw it.

luck_of_the_sea.name: Luck of the Sea
luck_of_the_sea.what: You catch more treasure when fishing.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.what: Your spear's jab pushes you forward.

mending.name: Mending
mending.what: Experience orbs you pick up fix the item.
mending.on: anything that wears out, like tools and armor

multishot.name: Multishot
multishot.what: Your crossbow shoots 3 arrows at once.

piercing.name: Piercing
piercing.what: Crossbow arrows go through mobs and hit the ones behind.

projectile_protection.name: Projectile Protection
projectile_protection.what: It protects you from arrows and other things shot at you.

protection.name: Protection
protection.what: It protects you from most kinds of damage.

punch.name: Punch
punch.what: Your arrows knock mobs farther back.

respiration.name: Respiration
respiration.what: You can stay underwater longer before you run out of air.

riptide.name: Riptide
riptide.what: Throwing the trident in water or rain launches you along with it.

silk_touch.name: Silk Touch
silk_touch.what: Blocks drop themselves, like glass or a grass block.

smite.name: Smite
smite.what: It does extra damage to undead mobs, like zombies and skeletons.

soul_speed.name: Soul Speed
soul_speed.what: You walk faster on soul sand and soul soil.

thorns.name: Thorns
thorns.what: It hurts mobs that hit you.

unbreaking.name: Unbreaking
unbreaking.what: The item lasts longer before it breaks.
unbreaking.on: anything that wears out, like tools and armor

vanishing_curse.name: Curse of Vanishing
vanishing_curse.what: It's a curse: the item disappears when you die.

wind_burst.name: Wind Burst
wind_burst.what: After a mace smash attack, you bounce up into the air.

fire_resistance.name: Fire Resistance
fire_resistance.what: Fire and lava can't hurt you.

invisibility.name: Invisibility
invisibility.what: You turn invisible, but armor you wear still shows.

blindness.name: Blindness
blindness.what: You can hardly see, and you can't sprint.

night_vision.name: Night Vision
night_vision.what: You can see in the dark.

poison.name: Poison
poison.what: Hurts you over time, but it can't take your last heart.

wither.name: Wither
wither.what: Hurts you over time and turns your hearts black. It can kill you.

absorption.name: Absorption
absorption.what: Gives you golden hearts that soak up damage.

levitation.name: Levitation
levitation.what: You float up into the air.

slow_falling.name: Slow Falling
slow_falling.what: You fall slowly and take no fall damage.

conduit_power.name: Conduit Power
conduit_power.what: Underwater you can breathe, see clearly and mine faster.

bad_omen.name: Bad Omen
bad_omen.what: Walk into a village with it and a raid starts.

hero_of_the_village.name: Hero of the Village
hero_of_the_village.what: Villagers give you lower prices and gifts.

darkness.name: Darkness
darkness.what: Your screen goes dark and pulses. The Warden gives you this.

trial_omen.name: Trial Omen
trial_omen.what: Trial spawners near you turn ominous: harder mobs and better loot.

raid_omen.name: Raid Omen
raid_omen.what: A raid is about to start in the village.

wind_charged.name: Wind Charged
wind_charged.what: When you die, you let out a big burst of wind.

weaving.name: Weaving
weaving.what: When you die, you leave cobwebs behind.

oozing.name: Oozing
oozing.what: When you die, two slimes appear.

infested.name: Infested
infested.what: Getting hurt can make silverfish come out of you.

best-food.title: The best food
best-food.say: Steak and cooked porkchops are the best everyday food: each fills 4 drumsticks and keeps you full a long time. Golden carrots keep you full even longer.

where.say: Allays are found in wooden cages at [pillager outposts](place:pillager_outpost) and in [woodland mansions](place:woodland_mansion).
Armadillos live in [savannas](biome:savanna) and [badlands](biome:badlands).

breed.say: Feed 2 armadillos [spider eyes](item:spider_eye), and a baby is born.

where.say: Axolotls live in [lush caves](biome:lush_caves), in the water underground.

tame.say: Axolotls can't be tamed, but you can carry one in a [water bucket](item:water_bucket).

breed.say: Feed 2 axolotls a [bucket of tropical fish](item:tropical_fish_bucket) each, and a baby is born.

dangerous.say: Axolotls are friendly to you. They fight [drowned](mob:drowned) and [guardians](mob:guardian), so they help you underwater.

where.say: Bees live in [bee nests](item:bee_nest) that hang from trees, often near flowers.

eats.say: Bees drink from flowers. Hold a flower, like a [dandelion](item:dandelion) or a [poppy](item:poppy), and they follow you.

breed.say: Feed 2 bees any flower, like a [dandelion](item:dandelion) or a [poppy](item:poppy), and a baby bee is born.

dangerous.say: Bees sting if you hit one, or take honey without a [campfire](item:campfire) under the nest. A sting can poison you.

where.say: Blazes live in Nether fortresses, around blaze spawners.
Bogged live in [swamps](biome:swamp) and [mangrove swamps](biome:mangrove_swamp), and in [trial chambers](place:trial_chambers).
Breezes come out of trial spawners in [trial chambers](place:trial_chambers), deep underground.
Camels live in [deserts](biome:desert), and there's one in the middle of each desert [village](place:village).

tame.say: Camels don't need taming. Put a [saddle](item:saddle) on one and ride it. 2 players can ride together.

breed.say: Feed 2 camels [cactus](item:cactus), and a baby is born.

where.say: Camel husks show up in [deserts](biome:desert), with a [husk](mob:husk) and a parched riding on them.
Cats live in [villages](place:village) and at [swamp huts](place:swamp_hut).

eats.say: Cats eat [raw cod](item:cod) and [raw salmon](item:salmon). Feeding a tamed cat heals it.

tame.say: Find a stray cat in a [village](place:village). Hold [raw cod](item:cod) or [raw salmon](item:salmon), stand still, and feed it when it comes close.

breed.say: Feed 2 tamed cats [raw cod](item:cod) or [raw salmon](item:salmon), and a kitten is born.

gifts.say: A tamed cat that sleeps on your [bed](item:white_bed) may leave a gift when you wake up: a [rabbit's foot](item:rabbit_foot), [rabbit hide](item:rabbit_hide), [string](item:string), a [feather](item:feather), [raw chicken](item:chicken), [rotten flesh](item:rotten_flesh) or a [phantom membrane](item:phantom_membrane).

dangerous.say: Cats are friendly. [Creepers](mob:creeper) run away from cats, and [phantoms](mob:phantom) stay away too.

where.say: Cave spiders live in [mineshafts](place:mineshaft), around cave spider spawners.
Chickens live in grassy places, like [plains](biome:plains) and [forests](biome:forest).

eats.say: Chickens eat seeds: [wheat seeds](item:wheat_seeds), [melon seeds](item:melon_seeds), [pumpkin seeds](item:pumpkin_seeds), [beetroot seeds](item:beetroot_seeds) and [torchflower seeds](item:torchflower_seeds).

breed.say: Feed 2 chickens seeds, and a chick is born. Throwing an [egg](item:egg) sometimes hatches a chick too.

where.say: Cod swim in [oceans](biome:ocean).
You build a copper golem: put a [carved pumpkin](item:carved_pumpkin) on top of a copper block.
Cows live in grassy places, like [plains](biome:plains) and [forests](biome:forest).

breed.say: Feed 2 cows [wheat](item:wheat), and a calf is born.

where.say: Creakings come out at night from a [creaking heart](item:creaking_heart), inside a pale oak tree in the [pale garden](biome:pale_garden).

dangerous.say: The creaking only moves when you're not looking at it. You can't hurt it: break its [creaking heart](item:creaking_heart) to stop it.

where.say: Creepers come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

dangerous.say: Creepers sneak up and explode. Run when one hisses. They're scared of [cats](mob:cat) and [ocelots](mob:ocelot).

where.say: Dolphins swim in most [oceans](biome:ocean), but not frozen or cold ones.
Donkeys live in [plains](biome:plains), [savannas](biome:savanna) and [meadows](biome:meadow).

eats.say: Horses eat [sugar](item:sugar), [wheat](item:wheat), [apples](item:apple), [carrots](item:carrot), [hay bales](item:hay_block), [golden carrots](item:golden_carrot) and [golden apples](item:golden_apple).

tame.say: Get on with an empty hand again and again until hearts show. Feeding it first helps it calm down faster.

breed.say: Feed 2 tamed horses [golden carrots](item:golden_carrot) or [golden apples](item:golden_apple). A horse and a [donkey](mob:donkey) make a [mule](mob:mule).

where.say: Drowned live in [oceans](biome:ocean) and [rivers](biome:river).

dangerous.say: Drowned attack from the water. Some throw [tridents](item:trident).

where.say: Elder guardians live in [ocean monuments](place:ocean_monument). Each monument has 3, and they never come back.
Endermen come out in the dark in the Overworld, and they live in the Nether and the End too.

dangerous.say: Endermen leave you alone unless you look at their face or hit one. Water hurts them.

where.say: Endermites sometimes pop out when you throw an [ender pearl](item:ender_pearl).
The Ender Dragon lives in the End. Find a [stronghold](place:stronghold) and go through its End portal.
Evokers live in [woodland mansions](place:woodland_mansion), and they show up in raids on [villages](place:village).
Foxes live in [taiga](biome:taiga) [forests](biome:forest), with the spruce trees.

tame.say: A grown fox never trusts you. Breed 2 foxes, and the baby trusts you.

breed.say: Sneak up slowly and feed 2 foxes [sweet berries](item:sweet_berries) or [glow berries](item:glow_berries), and a kit is born.

dangerous.say: Foxes run from you, but they hunt [chickens](mob:chicken), [rabbits](mob:rabbit) and fish.

where.say: Frogs live in [swamps](biome:swamp) and [mangrove swamps](biome:mangrove_swamp).

eats.say: Frogs eat small [slimes](mob:slime) and small [magma cubes](mob:magma_cube).

breed.say: Feed 2 frogs [slimeballs](item:slime_ball). One lays frogspawn in water, and [tadpoles](mob:tadpole) hatch from it.

where.say: Ghasts float around the Nether, in [soul sand valleys](biome:soul_sand_valley), [Nether wastes](biome:nether_wastes) and [basalt deltas](biome:basalt_deltas).

dangerous.say: Ghasts float in the Nether and shoot fireballs. Hit a fireball to send it back.

where.say: Grow one from a [dried ghast](item:dried_ghast): put it in water. Dried ghasts are found in [soul sand valleys](biome:soul_sand_valley) in the Nether.
Glow squid swim in dark water deep underground.
Goats live high up in snowy mountains.

breed.say: Feed 2 goats [wheat](item:wheat), and a kid is born.

dangerous.say: Goats sometimes run at you and knock you back, even off a cliff.

where.say: Guardians live in and around [ocean monuments](place:ocean_monument).
Hoglins live in [crimson forests](biome:crimson_forest) and [bastions](place:bastion), in the Nether.

breed.say: Feed 2 hoglins [crimson fungus](item:crimson_fungus), and a baby is born.

dangerous.say: Hoglins attack and hit hard. They're scared of [warped fungus](item:warped_fungus).

where.say: Horses live in [plains](biome:plains) and [savannas](biome:savanna).

eats.say: Horses eat [sugar](item:sugar), [wheat](item:wheat), [apples](item:apple), [carrots](item:carrot), [hay bales](item:hay_block), [golden carrots](item:golden_carrot) and [golden apples](item:golden_apple).

tame.say: Get on with an empty hand again and again until hearts show. Feeding it first helps it calm down faster.

breed.say: Feed 2 tamed horses [golden carrots](item:golden_carrot) or [golden apples](item:golden_apple). A horse and a [donkey](mob:donkey) make a [mule](mob:mule).

where.say: Husks come out in [deserts](biome:desert), in place of most [zombies](mob:zombie).
Iron golems guard [villages](place:village). You can also build one: 4 iron blocks in a T shape with a [carved pumpkin](item:carved_pumpkin) on top.

dangerous.say: Iron golems guard [villages](place:village). They attack you only if you hit a villager or the golem.

where.say: Llamas live in [savannas](biome:savanna) and [windswept hills](biome:windswept_hills).

tame.say: Get on with an empty hand again and again until hearts show. Then it can carry a [chest](item:chest).

breed.say: Feed 2 tamed llamas [hay bales](item:hay_block), and a baby is born.

dangerous.say: Llamas spit at [wolves](mob:wolf), and at you if you hit one. The spit only hurts a little.

where.say: Magma cubes live in the Nether, most of all in [basalt deltas](biome:basalt_deltas).
Mooshrooms only live in [mushroom fields](biome:mushroom_fields), a rare island biome.

breed.say: Feed 2 mooshrooms [wheat](item:wheat), and a calf is born.

where.say: Mules don't spawn on their own. Breed a [horse](mob:horse) with a [donkey](mob:donkey) to get one.

eats.say: Horses eat [sugar](item:sugar), [wheat](item:wheat), [apples](item:apple), [carrots](item:carrot), [hay bales](item:hay_block), [golden carrots](item:golden_carrot) and [golden apples](item:golden_apple).

tame.say: Get on with an empty hand again and again until hearts show. Feeding it first helps it calm down faster.

breed.say: Mules can't have babies. You get a mule by breeding a [horse](mob:horse) with a [donkey](mob:donkey).

where.say: Nautiluses swim in [oceans](biome:ocean).
Ocelots live in [jungles](biome:jungle).

tame.say: Ocelots can't be tamed, but they can learn to trust you. Hold [raw cod](item:cod) or [raw salmon](item:salmon), stand still, and feed it when it comes close.

breed.say: Feed 2 ocelots [raw cod](item:cod) or [raw salmon](item:salmon), and a baby is born.

dangerous.say: Ocelots run from you, but they hunt [chickens](mob:chicken). [Creepers](mob:creeper) run away from them.

where.say: Pandas live in [jungles](biome:jungle), most of all in [bamboo jungles](biome:bamboo_jungle).

breed.say: Feed 2 pandas [bamboo](item:bamboo). There must be at least 8 bamboo plants within 5 blocks of them.

where.say: Parched come out in [deserts](biome:desert). They're a kind of [skeleton](mob:skeleton).
Parrots live in [jungles](biome:jungle).

eats.say: Parrots eat seeds, like [wheat seeds](item:wheat_seeds) and [melon seeds](item:melon_seeds). Never give a parrot a [cookie](item:cookie): it's poison to them.

tame.say: Give a parrot seeds until hearts show. Then it can ride on your shoulder.

breed.say: Parrots can't have babies.

where.say: Phantoms come out at night if you haven't slept for 3 days or more.

dangerous.say: Phantoms swoop at you at night when you haven't slept for 3 days. Sleep in a [bed](item:white_bed) to stop them.

where.say: Pigs live in grassy places, like [plains](biome:plains) and [forests](biome:forest).

tame.say: Pigs don't need taming. Put a [saddle](item:saddle) on one and steer it with a [carrot on a stick](item:carrot_on_a_stick).

breed.say: Feed 2 pigs [carrots](item:carrot), [potatoes](item:potato) or [beetroots](item:beetroot), and a piglet is born.

where.say: Piglins live in the Nether, in [Nether wastes](biome:nether_wastes), [crimson forests](biome:crimson_forest) and [bastions](place:bastion).

dangerous.say: Piglins attack you unless you wear at least 1 piece of gold armor, like a [golden helmet](item:golden_helmet).

where.say: Piglin brutes only live in [bastions](place:bastion), in the Nether.
Pillagers live at [pillager outposts](place:pillager_outpost), walk around in patrols, and come in raids on [villages](place:village).
Polar bears live in [snowy plains](biome:snowy_plains), [ice spikes](biome:ice_spikes) and [frozen oceans](biome:frozen_ocean).

dangerous.say: Polar bears attack if you hit one or get close to a cub.

where.say: Pufferfish swim in warm and [lukewarm oceans](biome:lukewarm_ocean).

dangerous.say: Pufferfish puff up and poison you if you swim too close.

where.say: Rabbits live in [deserts](biome:desert), [flower forests](biome:flower_forest), [taigas](biome:taiga) and snowy places.

breed.say: Feed 2 rabbits [dandelions](item:dandelion), [carrots](item:carrot) or [golden carrots](item:golden_carrot), and a baby is born.

where.say: Ravagers come in raids on [villages](place:village).
Salmon swim in [rivers](biome:river) and [cold oceans](biome:cold_ocean).
Sheep live in grassy places, like [plains](biome:plains) and [forests](biome:forest).

eats.say: Sheep eat [wheat](item:wheat). They also eat grass to grow their [wool](item:white_wool) back.

breed.say: Feed 2 sheep [wheat](item:wheat), and a lamb is born. Its [wool](item:white_wool) mixes the colours of its parents when it can.

where.say: Shulkers live in [End cities](place:end_city), out on the End's outer islands.
Silverfish hide inside [stone](item:stone) blocks in [strongholds](place:stronghold) and mountains, and pop out when you break them.
Skeletons come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

dangerous.say: Skeletons shoot [arrows](item:arrow) at you. Hide behind blocks or block with a [shield](item:shield). Sunlight burns them.

where.say: Skeleton horses show up as a trap when lightning strikes in a thunderstorm.
Slimes come out in [swamps](biome:swamp) at night, and deep underground in some places called slime chunks.

dangerous.say: Big slimes hurt. Each one splits into smaller slimes when it dies. The tiniest ones can't hurt you.

where.say: Sniffers hatch from [sniffer eggs](item:sniffer_egg). Find the eggs in [suspicious sand](item:suspicious_sand) at warm [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins).

breed.say: Feed 2 sniffers [torchflower seeds](item:torchflower_seeds). One lays a [sniffer egg](item:sniffer_egg).

where.say: You build a snow golem: put a [carved pumpkin](item:carved_pumpkin) on top of 2 [snow blocks](item:snow_block).
Spiders come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

dangerous.say: Spiders attack in the dark. In daylight, they leave you alone unless you hit one.

where.say: Squid swim in [rivers](biome:river) and [oceans](biome:ocean).
Strays come out in snowy places, in place of most [skeletons](mob:skeleton).
Striders walk on the lava seas in the Nether.

tame.say: Striders don't need taming. Put a [saddle](item:saddle) on one and steer it across lava with a [warped fungus on a stick](item:warped_fungus_on_a_stick).

breed.say: Feed 2 striders [warped fungus](item:warped_fungus), and a baby is born.

where.say: Tadpoles hatch from frogspawn, the eggs [frogs](mob:frog) lay in water.
Trader llamas come with the wandering trader.
Tropical fish swim in warm and [lukewarm oceans](biome:lukewarm_ocean).
Turtles live on [beaches](biome:beach).

breed.say: Feed 2 turtles [seagrass](item:seagrass). One swims back to the [beach](biome:beach) where it hatched and lays [eggs](item:turtle_egg) in the [sand](item:sand).

where.say: Vexes only show up when an [evoker](mob:evoker) calls them.
Vindicators live in [woodland mansions](place:woodland_mansion), and they show up in raids on [villages](place:village).
The warden lives in the [deep dark](biome:deep_dark), far underground. [Sculk](item:sculk) shriekers call it, so sneak around them.

dangerous.say: The warden is the strongest mob. It can't see, so it finds you by sound. Sneak, and stay away.

where.say: Witches come out in the dark, and one lives in each [swamp hut](place:swamp_hut).

dangerous.say: Witches throw [potions](item:potion) that poison you and slow you down.

where.say: The wither is a boss you build: 4 [soul sand](item:soul_sand) in a T shape with 3 [wither skeleton skulls](item:wither_skeleton_skull) on top.
Wither skeletons live in Nether fortresses.
Wolves live in [forests](biome:forest), [taigas](biome:taiga) and [savannas](biome:savanna).

eats.say: Tamed wolves eat meat, raw or cooked, like [raw beef](item:beef), [raw chicken](item:chicken), [raw porkchop](item:porkchop), [raw mutton](item:mutton) and [raw rabbit](item:rabbit). [Rotten flesh](item:rotten_flesh) is fine too.

tame.say: Feed a wild wolf [bones](item:bone) until hearts show and it gets a red collar. It can take a few bones.

breed.say: Feed 2 tamed wolves at full health any meat, and a puppy is born.

dangerous.say: Wild wolves leave you alone unless you hit one. Then the whole pack attacks. A tamed wolf fights for you.

where.say: A zoglin is a [hoglin](mob:hoglin) that left the Nether. Hoglins turn into zoglins in the Overworld.
Zombies come out in the dark, at night and in caves.

dangerous.say: Zombies attack at night. Sunlight burns them, unless they wear a [helmet](item:iron_helmet).

where.say: Zombie horses are rare. Some come at night in [plains](biome:plains) and [savannas](biome:savanna), with a [zombie](mob:zombie) riding them.
[Zombie](mob:zombie) nautiluses swim in [oceans](biome:ocean), with a [drowned](mob:drowned) riding them.
Some [zombies](mob:zombie) are zombie villagers. A zombie can also turn a villager into one.

dangerous.say: Zombie villagers attack like [zombies](mob:zombie), but you can cure them.

where.say: Zombified piglins live in the Nether, and sometimes show up near Nether portals.

dangerous.say: Zombified piglins leave you alone unless you hit one. Then the whole group attacks.

where.say: Diamonds are deep underground. Look around level -59, near the bottom of the world.
Diamonds are deep underground. Look around level -59, near the bottom of the world.
Diamonds are deep underground. Look around level -59, near the bottom of the world.
Iron ore is in [stone](item:stone) underground and in mountains. Level 16 is a good place to look.
Iron ore is in [stone](item:stone) underground and in mountains. Level 16 is a good place to look.
Iron ore is in [stone](item:stone) underground and in mountains. Level 16 is a good place to look.
Iron ore is in [stone](item:stone) underground and in mountains. Level 16 is a good place to look.
Gold ore is deep underground, around level -16, and there's lots in [badlands](biome:badlands).
Gold ore is deep underground, around level -16, and there's lots in [badlands](biome:badlands).
Gold ore is deep underground, around level -16, and there's lots in [badlands](biome:badlands).
Gold ore is deep underground, around level -16, and there's lots in [badlands](biome:badlands).
Nether gold ore is all over the Nether. It gives you [gold nuggets](item:gold_nugget).
Coal ore is easy to find in [stone](item:stone), in caves and high up in mountains.
Coal ore is easy to find in [stone](item:stone), in caves and high up in mountains.
Coal ore is easy to find in [stone](item:stone), in caves and high up in mountains.
Copper ore is in [stone](item:stone) underground, most around level 48, and lots in [dripstone caves](biome:dripstone_caves).

Redstone ore is deep underground, near the bottom of the world.

Lapis lazuli ore is underground, most around level 0.

Emerald ore is only in mountains. You can also get emeralds by trading with villagers.

Ancient debris is in the Nether, most around level 16. You need a [diamond pickaxe](item:diamond_pickaxe) to mine it.
Netherite scrap comes from [ancient debris](item:ancient_debris), deep in the Nether. Smelt the debris in a [furnace](item:furnace).
Netherite scrap comes from [ancient debris](item:ancient_debris), deep in the Nether. Smelt the debris in a [furnace](item:furnace).
Nether quartz ore is all over the Nether.
Nether quartz ore is all over the Nether.
Amethyst is inside [amethyst geodes](place:amethyst_geode), round caves of purple crystal underground.
Budding amethyst is inside [amethyst geodes](place:amethyst_geode). It breaks if you mine it, even with Silk Touch.
Obsidian forms where water flows onto still lava. You can also find it at [ruined portals](place:ruined_portal).
Elytra are in [End cities](place:end_city), in an [item frame](item:item_frame) on the End ship. Beat the [Ender Dragon](mob:ender_dragon) first.

uses.say: Elytra are wings. Wear them, jump off something high, then jump again to glide. [Firework rockets](item:firework_rocket) make you fly faster.

where.say: Tridents come from [drowned](mob:drowned). Some drowned hold one, and they might drop it when you beat them.

uses.say: A trident is a weapon you can stab with or throw. You only get one from a [drowned](mob:drowned).

where.say: [Evokers](mob:evoker) always drop a totem of undying. Find them in [woodland mansions](place:woodland_mansion) and in raids.

uses.say: Hold a totem of undying in your hand, and it saves you once from dying.

where.say: The heart of the sea is in [buried treasure](place:buried_treasure) [chests](item:chest) on [beaches](biome:beach). Treasure maps from [shipwrecks](place:shipwreck) and [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins) show where.
[Drowned](mob:drowned) holding a nautilus shell can drop it. You can also fish one up or trade for one.
Sponges are in sponge rooms in [ocean monuments](place:ocean_monument). [Elder guardians](mob:elder_guardian) drop [wet sponges](item:wet_sponge) too.
You can craft a saddle. You can also find saddles in [chests](item:chest), fish one up, or trade for one.

uses.say: A saddle lets you ride a [horse](mob:horse), [donkey](mob:donkey), [mule](mob:mule), [pig](mob:pig), [strider](mob:strider) or [camel](mob:camel).

where.say: You can craft a name tag. You can also find them in [chests](item:chest), fish one up, or trade for one.

uses.say: A name tag gives a mob a name. Write the name on an [anvil](item:anvil) first. Named mobs never vanish.

where.say: Echo shards are in [chests](item:chest) in [ancient cities](place:ancient_city), in the [deep dark](biome:deep_dark).
Trial keys come from trial spawners in [trial chambers](place:trial_chambers), after you beat their mobs.
Heavy cores are in ominous vaults in [trial chambers](place:trial_chambers). They're rare.

Enchanted golden apples are rare finds in [chests](item:chest), like in [mineshafts](place:mineshaft), [dungeons](place:monster_room), [desert pyramids](place:desert_pyramid) and [ruined portals](place:ruined_portal).
The dragon egg shows up on top of the portal in the End after you beat the [Ender Dragon](mob:ender_dragon).
Slimes drop slimeballs. Find slimes in [swamps](biome:swamp) at night.
[Endermen](mob:enderman) drop ender pearls. You can also trade with villagers for them.

uses.say: Throw an ender pearl, and you teleport to where it lands. It hurts a little.

where.say: [Blazes](mob:blaze) drop blaze rods. Blazes live in Nether fortresses.
[Ghasts](mob:ghast) drop ghast tears. Find ghasts flying around the Nether.
[Shulkers](mob:shulker) drop shulker shells. They live in [End cities](place:end_city).
[Wither skeletons](mob:wither_skeleton) sometimes drop their skull. They live in Nether fortresses.
[Breezes](mob:breeze) drop breeze rods. They're in [trial chambers](place:trial_chambers).
[Armadillos](mob:armadillo) drop a scute now and then. [Brush](item:brush) an armadillo to get one.
[Goats](mob:goat) drop a horn when they ram into [stone](item:stone), [logs](item:oak_log), ore or [packed ice](item:packed_ice). [Pillager outposts](place:pillager_outpost) have them too.
Sniffer eggs are in [suspicious sand](item:suspicious_sand) at warm [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins). Use a [brush](item:brush) to dig them out.
[Turtles](mob:turtle) lay turtle eggs on [beaches](biome:beach) after you feed them [seagrass](item:seagrass).
[Chickens](mob:chicken) lay eggs every few minutes.
Use [shears](item:shears) on a full [bee nest](item:bee_nest) or [beehive](item:beehive). Put a [campfire](item:campfire) under it first so the [bees](mob:bee) stay calm.
Sugar cane grows next to water, on [sand](item:sand), [dirt](item:dirt) or grass.
Cactus grows in [deserts](biome:desert) and [badlands](biome:badlands).
Pumpkins grow in small patches in grassy places.
Melons grow in [jungles](biome:jungle).
Melons grow in [jungles](biome:jungle).
Bamboo grows in [jungles](biome:jungle), most of all in [bamboo jungles](biome:bamboo_jungle).
Cocoa beans grow in pods on the sides of [jungle](biome:jungle) trees. Break a pod when it turns orange.
[Sweet berry bushes](item:sweet_berry_bush) grow in [taigas](biome:taiga).
Logs come from trees. Chop the trunk of any tree.
Logs come from trees. Chop the trunk of any tree.

Sand is in [deserts](biome:desert), on [beaches](biome:beach), and on the bottom of [rivers](biome:river) and [oceans](biome:ocean).
Gravel is underground, on [beaches](biome:beach), and on the bottom of [oceans](biome:ocean).
Clay is on the bottom of lakes, [rivers](biome:river) and [swamps](biome:swamp).
Clay is on the bottom of lakes, [rivers](biome:river) and [swamps](biome:swamp).
Nether wart grows in Nether fortresses and [bastions](place:bastion).
Glowstone hangs from the ceiling in the Nether. Break it to get glowstone dust.
Glowstone hangs from the ceiling in the Nether. Break it to get glowstone dust.
Dried ghasts are in [soul sand valleys](biome:soul_sand_valley) in the Nether, next to big [bone](item:bone) fossils. You can also make one.
Pointed dripstone grows in [dripstone caves](biome:dripstone_caves), underground.
Moss is in [lush caves](biome:lush_caves), underground.
Mud is in [mangrove swamps](biome:mangrove_swamp). You can also make it: use a water bottle on [dirt](item:dirt).
Use an empty [bucket](item:bucket) on a [cow](mob:cow), a [goat](mob:goat) or a [mooshroom](mob:mooshroom) to fill it with milk.

uses.say: Drinking milk takes away all effects, like poison.

where.say: Use an empty [bucket](item:bucket) on water to fill it.
Bells are in [villages](place:village), at the meeting place in the middle.

Spawners are in [dungeons](place:monster_room), [mineshafts](place:mineshaft), Nether fortresses, [strongholds](place:stronghold) and [woodland mansions](place:woodland_mansion). You can't pick one up.
Dandelions are yellow flowers that grow on grass in most places, mostly in [plains](biome:plains).
Warped fungus grows in [warped forests](biome:warped_forest) in the Nether.
Crimson fungus grows in [crimson forests](biome:crimson_forest) in the Nether.
Use a [water bucket](item:water_bucket) on a [tropical fish](mob:tropical_fish) swimming in water to catch it.
Craft [paper](item:paper) with [gunpowder](item:gunpowder) to make 3 firework rockets. More gunpowder, up to 3, makes them fly longer.
Enchant a [book](item:book) on an [enchanting table](item:enchanting_table), catch one fishing, trade with a librarian villager, or find one in [chests](item:chest).
[Rabbits](mob:rabbit) sometimes drop a rabbit's foot. A tamed [cat](mob:cat) may also bring you one as a [gift](mob:cat#gifts).

Bee nests hang from trees. Every tree in a [meadow](biome:meadow) has one, and some trees in [plains](biome:plains), [flower forests](biome:flower_forest) and [cherry groves](biome:cherry_grove) do too.
Suspicious sand is under [desert pyramids](place:desert_pyramid), at the bottom of [desert](biome:desert) wells, and in warm [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins).
Suspicious gravel is in cold [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins) and [trail ruins](place:trail_ruins).
Use [shears](item:shears) on a [pumpkin](item:pumpkin) to carve a face in it. You get 4 [pumpkin seeds](item:pumpkin_seeds) too.
Use a [hoe](item:wooden_hoe) on [dirt](item:dirt) or grass to make farmland. Crops grow on it, faster when water is near.
Ice covers [frozen rivers](biome:frozen_river) and lakes in snowy places. Mine it with a Silk Touch [pickaxe](item:wooden_pickaxe), or it melts.
Make potions at a [brewing stand](item:brewing_stand), starting with water bottles. [Witches](mob:witch) drop them sometimes too.
Sculk covers the ground in the [deep dark](biome:deep_dark), far underground.
Soul sand is in the Nether, most of all in [soul sand valleys](biome:soul_sand_valley). Nether fortresses have some too.
Sweet berry bushes grow in [taigas](biome:taiga). Pick the berries when they turn red, and watch out: the bushes scratch.
Leaves grow on trees. Break them with [shears](item:shears) to keep them: anything else only drops a [sapling](item:oak_sapling) or a [stick](item:stick) now and then. Leaves you place never fall.

Vines hang from trees in [jungles](biome:jungle) and [swamps](biome:swamp). Cut them with [shears](item:shears) to keep them.
Add [gunpowder](item:gunpowder) to a [potion](item:potion) in a [brewing stand](item:brewing_stand) to make a splash potion that you throw.
Defeating the [Wither](mob:wither) drops a nether star. It is a very strong boss, so get help.
Calcite is the white [stone](item:stone) layer in [amethyst geodes](place:amethyst_geode), deep underground.
Cornflowers are blue flowers that grow in [plains](biome:plains), [flower forests](biome:flower_forest) and [meadows](biome:meadow).

uses.say: A compass points to the world's spawn, where you first started. Follow it to find your way back.
A recovery compass points to where you last died, so you can find your things.
A clock shows if it's day or night, even underground.
Use an empty map and it draws the land around you. It fills in as you walk.
A spyglass lets you zoom in to see things far away.
A lead ties to an animal so you can walk it, or tie it to a [fence](item:oak_fence).
Hold a shield in your other hand and sneak to block [arrows](item:arrow), hits and [creeper](mob:creeper) blasts.
A bucket carries water, lava or milk. It can also catch fish or an [axolotl](mob:axolotl) in water.
Bone meal makes crops, [saplings](item:oak_sapling) and flowers grow right away.
Throw an eye of ender, and it flies toward the nearest [stronghold](place:stronghold). Eyes also fill the End portal there.
Flint and steel starts fires and lights a [Nether portal](guide:nether-portal).
Shears cut the [wool](item:white_wool) off [sheep](mob:sheep) without hurting them. They also cut [leaves](item:oak_leaves), [vines](item:vine) and [cobwebs](item:cobweb).
Cast a fishing rod into water to catch fish, and sometimes treasure.
Use a brush on [suspicious sand](item:suspicious_sand) or [suspicious gravel](item:suspicious_gravel) to dig out old treasures.
Sleep in a bed to skip the night. It also sets where you come back after dying.

Torches light up dark places, so monsters can't spawn there.
An anvil fixes and names things, and adds [enchanted books](item:enchanted_book) to your gear. It costs XP.
A beacon on top of a pyramid of iron, gold, [emerald](item:emerald) or [diamond](item:diamond) blocks gives you powers nearby, like speed.
A brewing stand makes [potions](item:potion). It runs on [blaze powder](item:blaze_powder).
A note block plays a note when you hit it or power it. Use it to change the note.
A redstone lamp lights up when it gets power, like from a [lever](item:lever).
A lever turns redstone power on and off.
A golden apple heals you fast and gives you extra hearts for a while. It also helps cure a [zombie villager](mob:zombie_villager).
Hold it while riding a [pig](mob:pig) with a [saddle](item:saddle) to steer.
Hold it while riding a [strider](mob:strider) with a [saddle](item:saddle) to steer.
Fill a glass bottle with water to start a [potion](item:potion), or with honey from a full [beehive](item:beehive).
Drinking honey takes away poison and fills a little hunger.
A campfire cooks food. Under a [bee nest](item:bee_nest) or [beehive](item:beehive), its smoke keeps [bees](mob:bee) calm.
Rails make a track for a [minecart](item:minecart). [Powered rails](item:powered_rail) speed it up.

stronghold.name: Stronghold
stronghold.say: Strongholds are hidden underground. Throw an [eye of ender](item:ender_eye): it flies toward the nearest one.

woodland_mansion.name: Woodland mansion
woodland_mansion.say: Woodland mansions are in [dark forests](biome:dark_forest) and [pale gardens](biome:pale_garden). They're rare and far away, so a map from a cartographer villager helps.

ocean_monument.name: Ocean monument
ocean_monument.say: Ocean monuments are underwater in [deep oceans](biome:deep_ocean).

nether_fortress.name: Nether fortress
nether_fortress.say: Nether fortresses are in the Nether, in any biome. They're made of dark [Nether bricks](item:nether_bricks).

bastion.name: Bastion
bastion.say: Bastions are in the Nether, in every biome but [basalt deltas](biome:basalt_deltas). They're full of [piglins](mob:piglin) and gold.

end_city.name: End city
end_city.say: End cities are on the End's outer islands. Beat the [Ender Dragon](mob:ender_dragon), then go through the small gateway portal.

ancient_city.name: Ancient city
ancient_city.say: Ancient cities are in the [deep dark](biome:deep_dark), far underground, often under mountains.

trial_chambers.name: Trial chambers
trial_chambers.say: Trial chambers are underground, around level -40 to -20.

pillager_outpost.name: Pillager outpost
pillager_outpost.say: Pillager outposts are dark wooden towers in the same kinds of places as [villages](place:village), but rarer.

desert_pyramid.name: Desert pyramid
desert_pyramid.say: Desert pyramids are in [deserts](biome:desert). Watch out for the trap under the treasure room.

jungle_pyramid.name: Jungle temple
jungle_pyramid.say: Jungle temples are in [jungles](biome:jungle). Watch out for the traps inside.

swamp_hut.name: Swamp hut
swamp_hut.say: Swamp huts are in [swamps](biome:swamp). A [witch](mob:witch) and a black [cat](mob:cat) live there.

igloo.name: Igloo
igloo.say: Igloos are in [snowy plains](biome:snowy_plains) and [snowy taigas](biome:snowy_taiga). Some have a secret basement.

buried_treasure.name: Buried treasure
buried_treasure.say: Buried treasure is under the [sand](item:sand) on [beaches](biome:beach). Treasure maps from [shipwrecks](place:shipwreck) and [ocean ruins](place:ocean_ruins) show where.

ruined_portal.name: Ruined portal
ruined_portal.say: Ruined portals are all over the Overworld and the Nether.

mineshaft.name: Mineshaft
mineshaft.say: Mineshafts are underground, with [rails](item:rail) and wooden beams. In [badlands](biome:badlands) some are above ground.

monster_room.name: Dungeon
monster_room.say: Dungeons are small mossy rooms underground with a mob spawner and [chests](item:chest).

trail_ruins.name: Trail ruins
trail_ruins.say: Trail ruins are buried in [taigas](biome:taiga), [jungles](biome:jungle) and old [birch forests](biome:birch_forest). [Brush](item:brush) the [suspicious gravel](item:suspicious_gravel) to find treasure.

amethyst_geode.name: Amethyst geode
amethyst_geode.say: Amethyst geodes are underground, from deep down up to level 30.

nether_fossil.name: Nether fossil
nether_fossil.say: Nether fossils are big [bones](item:bone) in [soul sand valleys](biome:soul_sand_valley), in the Nether.

ocean_ruins.name: Ocean ruins
ocean_ruins.say: Ocean ruins are on the [ocean](biome:ocean) floor. [Warm oceans](biome:warm_ocean) have [sandstone](item:sandstone) ones and [cold oceans](biome:cold_ocean) have [stone](item:stone) ones.
